t: Modern Jund deck - MTG Wiki
s: January 9, 2026 - Jund is a deck for the Modern format which has its foundation in the Standard Jund deck, both of which named for the Jund shard of Alara, consisting of the colors black, red and green. It is an Aggro-control deck using black to force the opponent to discard as well as destroying creatures, red to deal damage directly and destroy lands, and green for utility and big creatures.
